text:
maya_cs: Heads-up — AcmeCorp flagged their March invoice is ~2.1M tokens LOWER than their dashboard. They attached the CSV export. Export has a few rows with negative token_delta. Can someone triage? :eyes:

sara_support: Do we have the export_id / S3 path and the customer's org id? I'll open a ticket.

maya_cs: export_id=exp_20260312_47, org=acmecorp-42, s3://redwood-exports/prod/2026/03/12/shard-07/manifest.json

javier_billing: Negative token rows will reduce invoice if aggregation includes them. Need a small sample of the CSV lines (masked) and the total token delta for that export.

maya_cs: sample from CSV (sanitized):
```
2026-03-12T07:12:03Z,acmecorp-42,req_9a3f,model-x, -1200, prompt_len=0, reason=tz-adjust
2026-03-12T07:12:03Z,acmecorp-42,req_9a3f,model-x, +900, prompt_len=32, reason=ok
2026-03-12T08:05:11Z,acmecorp-42,req_b12e,model-x, -450, prompt_len=0, reason=empty_frame
```
Those negative rows sum to -1,987,600 tokens across shards for that day (rough customer-provided total).

lin_eng: Interesting. Negative deltas with prompt_len=0 look like a reclassification/dedup flip where an earlier positive row got later replaced by a zero-length tombstone. Did we recently change the dedupe key/hash or the window flush behavior?

ops_bot: ingest-dedupe job run: ingest-dedupe/2026-03-12-07-shard-07 finished. commit_rows=0, scanned=1,234,567, exit=0. log snippet: "WARN: hash_mismatch_count=1732; tombstone_emitted=421"

lin_eng: That log is telling — dedupe emitted tombstones for some signatures. I suspect a change in the rolling-hash kernel on 2026-03-11 caused identical requests to compute different dedupe keys across two batches. When tombstones later reappeared they had negative token_delta semantics in the CSV export.

javier_billing: If that's true, invoice shortfall is real. We need to both repair historical aggregation and prevent recurrence. What's repro?

lin_eng: Repro steps: 1) take two identical request payloads, run through the old vs new hash binary, compare signature bytes. 2) re-run ingest-dedupe on a copy of shard-07 for 2026-03-12 with corrected hash and confirm tombstones disappear. Quick curl to fetch the raw shard for testing:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://internal-api.redwood.io/exports/exp_20260312_47/shard/07/raw?start=2026-03-12T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-13T00:00:00Z" -o shard07.csv
```

oliver_pm: Customer comms: propose ASAP acknowledgment + ETA for fix. If re-aggregation will take >24h offer provisional credit and follow-up with corrected invoice. 

maya_cs: Agreed. I'll tell Acme: we found an ingestion/dedupe bug, backfill + re-aggregation is in progress. ETA ~36-48h, provisional credit available on request.

lin_eng: Plan of record: 1) Deploy dedupe kernel fix (PR ready) 2) Re-run dedupe on affected shards with corrected hash 3) Run aggregation + regen exports 4) Validate totals vs dashboard 5) Push corrected invoice. I'll lead steps 1-3.

javier_billing: Need exact impact numbers before we promise credits. Can you confirm total missing token delta and number of impacted customers?

lin_eng: Quick estimate from shard scan: impacted tokens ~2,147,600 (matches customer's rough). Affected orgs currently = 3 (AcmeCorp + two SMB accounts). I'll produce exact counts in next 2 hours.

ops_bot: backfill job queued: bf-run/2026-03-13-089 targeting exp_20260312_47 shards [07,09]. status=queued.

sara_support: I'll draft the message to Acme and post here for review before sending. Maya, add the ticket link when ready.

maya_cs: Ticket created: SUP-2026-4887. I'll paste the draft once Sara posts it. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

lin_eng: Follow-up: hotfix merged to main (hash restore). Starting reingest now on test copy, then prod. Will update with job ids.

ops_bot: backfill job started: bf-run/2026-03-13-089 -> job-id bf-89-prod. ETA 30-40h based on current throughput.

javier_billing: Once backfill completes, run aggregation and produce a delta report we can use to create corrected invoices and any credits.

maya_cs: Sending interim note to Acme: "We identified an ingestion/dedupe regression that created negative rows in the usage export. We're running a repair and backfill; expected completion ~36–48h. We'll notify with corrected invoice or provisional credit. Apologies for the disruption." Will share once Sara finalizes copy.
